description: This file defines an abstract Spring Boot configuration class for setting up various client factories, connections, caches, and health check components within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides bean definitions for tracing, vert.x, messaging, registration, credentials, tenant, device connection services, command handling, and resource limits, with hooks for customization.

classes.name: AbstractAdapterConfig
classes.description: An abstract Spring Boot configuration class providing bean definitions for various Hono service components such as tracing, messaging, registration, device connection, command handling, cache management, and resource limits.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Provides an OpenTracing Tracer bean, resolving it via a tracer resolver or defaults to a No-op tracer.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Provides a Vert.x instance configured with properties.

methods.name: downstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns configuration properties for messaging network access, with potential subclass customization.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to customize messaging config properties.

methods.name: downstreamSenderFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for downstream messaging clients.

methods.name: downstreamConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the messaging network.

methods.name: registrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Provides registration service configuration properties with a default hostname if not set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to customize registration config.

methods.name: registrationClientFactory
methods.description: Creates a registration client factory.

methods.name: registrationServiceConnection
methods.description: Creates a connection to the registration service.

methods.name: registrationCacheProvider
methods.description: Provides a cache provider for registration data.

methods.name: credentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Provides credentials service configuration properties.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Hook for subclasses for credentials config.

methods.name: credentialsClientFactory
methods.description: Creates a credentials client factory.

methods.name: credentialsServiceConnection
methods.description: Establishes connection to credentials service.

methods.name: credentialsCacheProvider
methods.description: Provides cache for credentials data.

methods.name: tenantServiceClientConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant service configuration properties.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Hook for tenant config customization.

methods.name: tenantClientFactory
methods.description: Creates a tenant client factory.

methods.name: tenantServiceConnection
methods.description: Establishes connection to tenant service.

methods.name: tenantCacheProvider
methods.description: Provides cache for tenant data.

methods.name: deviceConnectionClientFactory
methods.description: Creates a device connection client factory.

methods.name: deviceConnectionServiceConnection
methods.description: Establishes connection to device connection service.

methods.name: deviceConnectionServiceClientConfig
methods.description: Config properties for device connection service.

methods.name: customizeDeviceConnectionClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Hook for customization of device connection config.

methods.name: commandConsumerFactoryConfig
methods.description: Configuration properties for command consumer.

methods.name: commandConsumerFactory
methods.description: Creates a command consumer factory.

methods.name: commandConsumerConnection
methods.description: Connection for command consumer.

methods.name: gatewayMapper
methods.description: Creates a GatewayMapper for device-to-gateway mapping.

methods.name: vertxProperties
methods.description: Provides Vert.x configuration properties.

methods.name: newCaffeineCache
methods.description: Utility methods to create caffeine-based cache providers.

methods.name: applicationConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides application-wide configuration properties.

methods.name: healthCheckConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides health check server configuration.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Creates and exposes a health check server instance.

methods.name: resourceLimitChecksConfig
methods.description: Configuration properties for resource limit checks based on Prometheus metrics.

methods.name: resourceLimitChecks
methods.description: Creates ResourceLimitChecks instance utilizing prometheus data.
